statement: An employer must register as an employer with Inland Revenue as soon as they start employing staff, either in myIR ('Register as an Employer (EMP) or IR56 worker' under registrations) or on the paper IR334 employer registration form.
caveat: Registration brings the PAYE obligations with it (payday filing of employment information, PAYE deductions, and KiwiSaver duties), which carry their own deadlines on the Inland Revenue pages. Check the live guidance for who counts as an employer before relying.
